verdict.rationale: llamafile is a local LLM server with an HTTP API, so an Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint is a fair question for it. The evidence only shows a generic 'HTTP server, API, Web UI' option set and the llama.cpp Web UI on localhost:8080. Nothing documents an Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint or Anthropic request/response compatibility.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call the server through an Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint
